Title:
AI Specialist

Company:
Omran Sanat Akam

Job category:
Web, programming, and software

Location:
Tehran

Employment type:
Full-time

Minimum experience:
Less than three years

Salary:
From 28,000,000 Tomans

Required skill tags:
- Artificial Intelligence
- Python
- N8n

Gender:
Not applicable

Military service:
Not applicable

Education:
Bachelor's degree

Date posted:
2026-06-21

Valid through:
(not available)

Job description:
The Akam team, a young and leading team in the fields of architecture and graphic design, is looking for a young artificial intelligence specialist to join their creative and dynamic group. The job description is for someone who is well-acquainted with artificial intelligence tools and engines, has the ability to perform professional prompt engineering, and can increase team efficiency through process automation (n8n) and Python programming. This person works alongside the architecture and graphic design team and helps them in the intelligent use of AI tools. Responsibilities include designing, testing, and optimizing prompts for various AI models, implementing automation workflows with n8n, developing scripts and helper tools with Python, collaborating closely with the architecture and graphic design team, and helping them apply AI tools in the design process. Monitoring and introducing new AI engines and tools to the team, documenting processes and implemented solutions, mastering the skills and conditions required for professional prompt engineering for language and image models, complete familiarity with current AI engines (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, and similar), mastering n8n for designing and executing automation workflows, programming skills in Python, ability to work in a team and communicate effectively with creative teams (Architecture/Graphic Design), analytical mindset, and a desire for continuous learning of new technologies are considered advantages. Familiarity with basic architectural or graphic design concepts, work experience in combined AI and visual design projects. Why join us? A young, dynamic, and creative work environment, the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI and architectural/graphic design, freedom to propose and implement new ideas. Working hours: Saturday to Wednesday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Office location: Dolat Street (Shahid Kalahedoz)

Company description:
Omran Sanat Akam has over two decades of experience, being one of the leading groups in the fields of architecture, civil engineering, and graphic design. By combining engineering knowledge, creativity, and an innovative outlook, it has executed various projects for government organizations, private companies, and various brands. With a multidisciplinary approach, Akam offers services ranging from the design and execution of architectural and civil engineering projects to graphic design, advertising, branding, research and development (R&D), consulting, and market analysis. The presence of specialists from various fields together has made it possible for every project to reach a result with a comprehensive, accurate, and creative perspective. What distinguishes Akam is not just the execution of projects; it is an organizational culture based on continuous learning, teamwork, responsibility, innovation, and quality focus. We believe that the most valuable asset of any organization is its people, and for this reason, we always strive to create a professional, dynamic, and inspiring environment; an environment where ideas are heard, talents find opportunities to grow, and quality is the result of the cooperation of a capable team. Today, relying on experience, expertise, and a forward-looking perspective, Akam continues its path with the goal of creating lasting projects and providing effective solutions in the fields of architecture, civil engineering, and visual communication.
